title: MQTT Subscriber Driver Configuration
description: Per-driver-type schema for `type: mqtt_subscriber` entries (FR-DF-004; Sprint C5, XEDGE-450; CRD §4.10). Subscribes to an external MQTT broker and maps incoming messages into tags -- independent of, and unrelated to, the northbound Sparkplug B publisher/NCMD path.

tls_enabled.description: Independent of the fleet agent's own certificate (XEDGE-442) -- a customer's MQTT broker is typically a separate trust domain from xEdge's fleet PKI.

tls_ca_certs_path.description: CA bundle verifying the broker's certificate. Omit to use the system trust store.

tls_insecure.description: Disables broker *hostname* verification only (not certificate validity).

scan_rate_ms.description: Accepted but unused: MQTT subscriptions are push-based, not polled, so there is no scan rate to configure. Present only so the Web UI's driver-type-agnostic 'add tag group' flow (which stubs every new group with a default scan_rate_ms, matching every poll-based driver type) doesn't fail validation for this one push-based type.

topic.description: MQTT topic filter; may use +/# wildcards. A wildcard subscription maps every matching concrete topic onto this same tag -- there is no per-topic fan-out into dynamically created tags.

payload_format.description: 'raw': decode as UTF-8 text, then auto-coerce to bool/int/float/string. 'json': parse as JSON, optionally narrowed by json_path.

json_path.description: Dot-separated key/index path into a JSON payload, e.g. 'data.value' or 'readings.0.temp'. Only used when payload_format is 'json'; omit to use the whole decoded JSON value.

scaling.description: Applied only to numeric values (int/float); ignored for bool/string payloads.
